purpose: Zero-shot OOD benchmark for ARGOS temporal stereo refiners (Agent B)
argos_refiner_upstream: S2M2-S @ 512 (pretrained, zero-shot) — refiners correct this raw disparity

SERV-CT.gt: dense disparity (px) + depth (mm) + valid mask, aligned to LEFT rectified image
SERV-CT.disp_convention: positive pixel disparity, left reference (matches ARGOS/S2M2)
SERV-CT.temporal: each Experiment is an ordered set of pairs; continuity WEAK/SPARSE
SERV-CT.raw_disparity_status: ABSENT — pretrained S2M2-S inference required (zero-shot upstream)
SERV-CT.license: SERV-CT (Edwards et al. 2020), academic use; cite original

D4D.gt: Zivid structured-light scans (depth_images + pointcloud), ~2 per session at scan timepoints
D4D.rectified: params available (R,P per side); must apply cv2.remap
D4D.disp_convention: after rectification: positive px left reference (to be produced)
D4D.temporal: true temporal video within clips (ordered frames, ~fps continuity)
D4D.license: D4D Dresden 4D (Wagner et al.), academic use; cite original
D4D.blocker: no dense per-frame GT disparity — requires Zivid pointcloud reprojection + per-frame pose to build GT

headline.servct: READY for zero-shot after S2M2-S raw-disp generation; dense GT; weak temporal.
headline.d4d: NOT READY — no dense per-frame GT disparity; heavy Zivid->disp conversion required.
